test_text_augmentation_transforms: run the unittest suite to test all augly text augmentation transforms
test_contractions_transform: test the Contractions transform to convert phrases like 'I would' into contractions like 'I'd'
test_encode_text_base64: test the EncodeTextTransform to encode text to base64 at sentence or word granularity
test_simulate_typos: test the SimulateTypos transform to introduce random typos into text with configurable probability
test_swap_gendered_words: test the SwapGenderedWords transform to swap gendered words like king/queen and son/daughter
